job.location: Menlo Park, CA · New York, NY
job.workplace: In office at least 3 days a week

details.about: Robinhood's mission is to democratize finance for all. Its engineering group includes the Brokerage, Incentives and Identity teams, which build and scale the services behind trading, personalized rewards and fraud prevention, working with Data Science, Crypto, Security and Product. In this Government Products role you design, build and own backend services, infrastructure and data systems for Robinhood's core products, with strict correctness standards.
duties: Design, build, test and deploy scalable backend services and systems built for long-term maintainability
Develop product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness and scalability standards
Find and make improvements to system performance, engineering productivity and risk reduction
Work closely with client teams, product partners and external vendors to deliver technical solutions
needs: A strong track record of delivering large-scope technical projects with engineering, product and operations partners
Commitment to high standards in code quality and code review
Solid understanding of backend development, system design and where product and engineering meet
Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar data streaming technologies
Familiarity with managing and processing large-scale datasets
nice: Experience at a fintech company or financial institution
Familiarity with Postgres, Kubernetes, Redis and AWS (or similar cloud platforms)
details.benefits: Base pay $166,000 – $195,000 a year in Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC), plus bonus opportunities, equity and benefits. Robinhood lists performance-driven compensation, bonus programs, equity ownership and 401(k) matching; 100% paid health insurance for employees and 90% coverage for dependents; access to the Robinhood Employee Fund for eligible US employees; a lifestyle wallet for wellness and learning; employer-paid life and disability insurance, fertility and mental health benefits; company holidays, paid time off, sick time and parental leave; and catered meals in the office.
notes: Based in Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY, in the office at least 3 days a week
Restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents
Other zones: $147,000 – $172,000 (Denver, Westlake TX, Chicago); $130,000 – $152,000 (Lake Mary, Clearwater, Gainesville FL)

yt_title: Robinhood Is Hiring: Backend Software Engineer | Menlo Park & New York | $166K–$195K

scenes.head: Today's job
bullets: Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY
lines: Welcome to Veritas Recruitment Agency, where we bring you real tech jobs straight from employers' own careers sites.
Today, Robinhood is hiring a backend software engineer for its Government Products work, based in Menlo Park, California, or New York City.
You'll find the direct application link in the description.

scenes.head: About Robinhood
lines: Robinhood's mission is to democratize finance for all.
Its engineering group includes the Brokerage, Incentives, and Identity teams, which build the services behind trading, personalized rewards, and fraud prevention.
In this role, you'll own backend services, infrastructure, and data systems for Robinhood's core products, where correctness really matters.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Design, build, test & deploy backend services
lines: You'll design, build, test, and deploy scalable backend services that are built to last.
You'll ship product features and platform improvements that meet strict standards for correctness and scale.
You'll find ways to improve performance, engineering productivity, and risk reduction.
And you'll work closely with client teams, product partners, and outside vendors.

scenes.head: What you need
bullets: Bonus: fintech, Postgres, K8s, Redis, AWS
lines: You'll need two or more years of software development, and a track record of delivering large projects with engineering, product, and operations partners.
You should be strong in Go or Python, have hands-on experience with Kafka or similar streaming tools, and be comfortable with large datasets and system design.
Bonus points for fintech experience, or for knowing Postgres, Kubernetes, Redis, and A W S.
show: You'll need 2+ years of software development, and a track record of delivering large projects with engineering, product, and operations partners.
Bonus points for fintech experience, or for knowing Postgres, Kubernetes, Redis, and AWS.

scenes.head: Pay & benefits
lines: Base pay in Menlo Park and New York is one hundred sixty-six thousand to one hundred ninety-five thousand dollars a year, plus bonus and equity.
Robinhood also offers four-oh-one-k matching, fully paid health insurance for employees, life and disability cover, fertility and mental health benefits, and paid time off.
The role is in the office at least three days a week, and it's open to U S citizens and permanent residents only.
